sources.snippet: Model Garden provides a collection of state-of-the-art machine learning (ML) models for vision, text, and audio capabilities. sources.title: North Korea Axios npm Attack: 100M Downloads Hit [2026]
sources.snippet: North Korean hackers hijacked the axios npm package with 100M weekly downloads, deploying WAVESHAPER.V2 malware in a 3-hour supply chain attack on March 31, 2026.
